format_of_entries.s24: 2:4 along K (each group of 4 consecutive inputs of every weight row, in the kernel basis, keeps <= 2 non-zeros). layers [..]; gemms [Win, Wo, Wgu, Wd]; role 'all' = every row through the sparse weights, 's' = state rows sparse, question rows (rows >= q0: question text, options, readout) through the dense weights of the base format (two weight copies); prec bf16n (natural basis) | int8 | int4 (rotated H1 FORMAT v1 arithmetic, per-token absmax activations, per-channel weight scales); method = how the 2 kept weights were chosen
format_of_entries.neur: MLP neuron removal per layer: removed neurons' gate/up rows and down columns deleted, mean replacement folded into a down-projection bias (exact), optional least-squares update of the kept down-projection columns
format_of_entries.base fmt: Q1/H1 format of every non-structured GEMM/row, e.g. b8 = W8A8-GPTQ with 8 GEMMs in bf16

accurate_settings.name: b8+nr.G12-23.dsalc.f0.6
accurate_settings.what: W8A8-b8 (H1/Q1 FORMAT v1, GPTQ codes from H1's calibration) with B12 applied first: 60% of the SwiGLU neurons of layers 12-23 removed (44,237 of 73,728; global decision-saliency ranking; decision-weighted least-squares update of the kept down-projection columns; removed means folded into a down-projection bias, added after the GEMM). accurate_settings.name: nr.G12-23.dsalc.f0.6
accurate_settings.what: B12: remove 60% of the SwiGLU neurons of layers 12-23 (44,237 of 73,728), ranked GLOBALLY across those layers by Fisher-weighted decision saliency of mean replacement (sum over requests and Fisher directions of lam * (sum_t dD/dm_tj (m_tj - mu_j))^2); delete their gate and up rows and down columns; update the kept down-projection columns by decision-weighted least squares (W_R += W_S C_SR C_RR^-1 with C the decision-weighted covariance of m, 1% damping) and fold the removed neurons' weighted means into a down-projection bias. Calibration: 160 banking + 160 retail train-split requests. bf16 elsewhere.
